# Points sub-actions

## Add points

Gives points to a viewer, like a reward for a trivia win. Points are your channel currency that viewers collect.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Amount** | How many points to give, a whole number like 100. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |
| **Apply user/group multipliers** | Tick to give more (or less) points if the viewer or their group has a points multiplier. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Also save the balance in variable** | Optional. A variable to also receive their new total, without % signs, like userPoints. Empty = only %points%. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total after the change |
| `%pointsAdded%` | How many points were really given |
| `%pointsUser%` | The viewer's name |
| `%pointsName%` | The name of the points |

<small>Type id: `points.add`</small>

## Award points to all

Gives points to every viewer Cuebot knows, or only to those who are around. Good for a "free points for everyone" moment.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only give to viewers on this site. Empty = every site. |
| **Amount** | How many points each viewer gets, a whole number like 10. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Only active (present) users** | Tick to give only to viewers who chatted recently, not to everyone Cuebot has ever seen. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Apply user/group multipliers** | Tick to give more (or less) points to viewers or groups with a points multiplier. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsAwarded%` | How many viewers got points |

<small>Type id: `points.awardAll`</small>

## Award points to group

Gives points to every viewer in a group, like "VIPs". Groups are made on the Users & Groups page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name, like "VIPs". |
| **Amount** | How many points each member gets, a whole number like 10. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Apply multipliers** | Tick to give more (or less) points to viewers or groups with a points multiplier. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsAwarded%` | How many viewers got points |

<small>Type id: `points.awardGroup`</small>

## Award points to present viewers

Gives points to every viewer who chatted recently. Good for a "thanks for being here" bonus.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only give to viewers on this site. Empty = every site. |
| **Amount** | How many points each viewer gets, a whole number like 10. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Apply multipliers** | Tick to give more (or less) points to viewers or groups with a points multiplier. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsAwarded%` | How many viewers got points |

<small>Type id: `points.awardPresent`</small>

## Check points

Checks if a viewer has enough points, then runs the Enough steps if yes or the Not enough steps if no. It takes no points. Good before a paid action.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Amount** | How many points are needed, a whole number like 100. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Stop the action when not enough** | Tick to stop the whole action when they do not have enough. Untick to run the Not enough steps instead. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Also save the balance in variable** | A variable to also receive their total, without % signs. The default userPoints means you can use %userPoints%. Starts as: `userPoints`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

Paths it can take: **Enough**, **Not enough**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total points |
| `%pointsEnough%` | True if they have enough |
| `%pointsMissing%` | How many more points they need (0 if enough) |

<small>Type id: `points.check`</small>

## Delete user points

Removes a viewer from the points list completely, as if they never had any. Use "Reset user points" if you only want zero.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsDeleted%` | True if they had points that were deleted |

<small>Type id: `points.delete`</small>

## Get points

Looks up how many points a viewer has and puts it in a variable. Good for a !points command that tells chat their total.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. The default %input0% is the first word after the command. Empty = whoever started the action. Starts as: `%input0%`. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total points |
| `%pointsFormatted%` | The total with the points name, like 500 Coins |
| `%pointsRank%` | Their place in the points ranking (1 = first) |
| `%pointsUser%` | The viewer's name |
| `%pointsName%` | The name of the points |

<small>Type id: `points.get`</small>

## Get points definition

Reads how a points currency is set up (its name, symbol and so on) and saves it in variables. Mostly for advanced uses.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |
| **Save in variable** | The start of the variable names, without % signs. The default pointsDefinition gives %pointsDefinition.name% and more. Starts as: `pointsDefinition`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsDefinition.name%` | The name of the points (the start can be changed in the settings) |
| `%pointsDefinition.singularName%` | The name for one point, like Coin |
| `%pointsDefinition.symbol%` | The symbol, if any |

<small>Type id: `points.getDefinition`</small>

## Get points leaderboard

Builds the top list of viewers with the most points, as text for chat and as variables. Good for a !top command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **How many** | How many viewers to list, like 5. Starts as: `5`. |
| **Skip the first (offset)** | How many places to skip. 0 starts at first place, 5 starts at sixth. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Platform** | Only list viewers on this site. Empty = every site. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%leaderboard%` | The list as one line, like "1. Kris (500 Coins), 2. Sam (400 Coins)" |
| `%leaderboardCount%` | How many viewers are in the list |
| `%leaderboard1User%` | The name of first place (leaderboard2User is second, and so on) |
| `%leaderboard1Points%` | The points of first place (leaderboard2Points is second, and so on) |

<small>Type id: `points.leaderboard`</small>

## Get points multiplier

Looks up how fast a viewer earns points. 1 is normal, 2 is double. Their group can change it too.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsMultiplier%` | How fast they earn points in all (1 = normal) |
| `%pointsUserMultiplier%` | The multiplier set just for them (1 if none) |

<small>Type id: `points.getMultiplier`</small>

## Remove points

Takes points away from a viewer. Their total never goes below 0. Use "all" to empty their balance.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Amount** | How many points to take, a whole number like 50, or the word all. Their total never goes below 0. Starts as: `10`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total after the change |
| `%pointsRemoved%` | How many points were really taken |

<small>Type id: `points.remove`</small>

## Reset everyone's points

Sets everyone's points back to zero. Be careful: this cannot be undone. Good for a fresh start each season.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only reset viewers on this site. Empty = every site. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsReset%` | How many viewers were reset |

<small>Type id: `points.resetAll`</small>

## Reset user points

Sets one viewer's points back to zero. The viewer stays in the list. Use "Delete user points" to remove them completely.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Also save the balance in variable** | A variable to also receive their new total, without % signs. The default userPoints means you can use %userPoints%. Starts as: `userPoints`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total after the reset (0) |

<small>Type id: `points.resetUser`</small>

## Set group points multiplier

Makes everyone in a group earn points faster or slower, like 2 for double. Good for rewarding "Subscribers" or "VIPs".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name, like "VIPs". |
| **Multiplier** | How much faster, like 2 for double or 1.5 for one and a half times. Empty removes the group's multiplier. Starts as: `2`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

<small>Type id: `points.setGroupMultiplier`</small>

## Set points

Sets a viewer's points to exactly a number, no matter how many they had before. Use "Add points" to give extra instead.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Amount** | The new total, a whole number like 500. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total after the change |

<small>Type id: `points.set`</small>

## Set user points multiplier

Makes one viewer earn points faster or slower, like 2 for double. Good as a special thank-you for a supporter.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Multiplier** | How much faster, like 2 for double or 1.5 for one and a half times. Empty removes their multiplier. Starts as: `2`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pointsMultiplier%` | How fast they earn points in all now |

<small>Type id: `points.setUserMultiplier`</small>

## Spend points

Charges a viewer points, if they have enough. It runs the Paid steps if it worked or the Not enough steps if they were too poor. Good for paid commands.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the viewer is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The viewer's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. Viewers must have chatted before. |
| **User id** | Optional. The viewer's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **Amount** | How many points it costs, a whole number like 100, or the word all. Starts as: `100`. |
| **Stop the action when not enough** | Tick to stop the whole action when they cannot pay. Untick to run the Not enough steps instead. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

Paths it can take: **Paid**, **Not enough**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The viewer's total after the payment |
| `%pointsSpent%` | True if the payment worked |
| `%pointsCost%` | How many points it cost |
| `%pointsMissing%` | How many more points they would have needed (0 if paid) |

<small>Type id: `points.spend`</small>

## Transfer points

Moves points from one viewer to another, like a !give command. It runs the Transferred steps if it worked or the Failed steps if not.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | The site the giver is on, like twitch. Empty = the site of whoever started the action. |
| **User name** | The giver's chat name. Empty = whoever started the action. |
| **User id** | Optional. The giver's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **To user name** | Who gets the points. The default %input0% is the first word after the command, like !give kris 50. Starts as: `%input0%`. |
| **To user id** | Optional. The receiver's id on their site. If given, it is used instead of the name. |
| **To platform** | The site the receiver is on. Empty = the same site as the giver. |
| **Amount** | How many points to give. The default %input1% is the second word after the command. A whole number, or the word all. Starts as: `%input1%`. |
| **Currency** | The name of the points, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

Paths it can take: **Transferred**, **Failed**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%points%` | The giver's total after the transfer |
| `%pointsTransferred%` | How many points were moved |
| `%targetPoints%` | The receiver's total after the transfer |
| `%pointsError%` | If it failed: the reason, like "not enough points" |

<small>Type id: `points.transfer`</small>
